title: A one-room gallery opens
text:
A one-room gallery on the east side opened last week with forty prints by Vex Tarrow, all of them of the same intersection photographed over nine years.

Tarrow, who has shown in Austin twice before, said the intersection was chosen because it was the one visible from a job they no longer have.

The gallery is open at weekends until March. The prints are not for sale.
